card.title: Ju 87 B2
card.text: Deployment: Add a DIVE BOMBING to your hand.
card.flavorText: The Junkers Ju 87 B2, most commonly known as Stuka, was a German dive bomber used by the Luftwaffe during WWII. The B series became the first mass produced variant, and after testing in Spain some 336 aircraft were ready for operations at the start of WWII. The variant came with general improvements, a redesigned fuselage and landing gear and the later B1 version was the first version with the "Jericho Trumpets" installed, named for its signature sound. Other changes from B1 to B2 were not significant, except that the B2 had various ski equipped versions produced and others with a tropical operation kit called the Ju 87 B-2 trop.
